name: radio-network-offline-alerts
goal: Time-sensitive push when the Zigbee coordinator, Z-Wave controller or UPS has been unavailable for 3 minutes

userStories.title: Confirm trigger entities
userStories.description: Verify coordinator, ZWA-2 controller and UPS entity ids plus unavailable behavior from registry and recorder
acceptanceCriteria: Each of the three entity_ids exists and is enabled in core.entity_registry
Normal state and unavailable-on-integration-down evidence recorded in working-memory.md
No guessed ids; unverified ones flagged to John before task-2

userStories.title: Zigbee coordinator offline alert
acceptanceCriteria: id zigbee_coordinator_offline, alias 'Zigbee - Coordinator Offline', 1-3 line header, mode single
trigger: state, coordinator entity, to unavailable, for 3 min
script.general_notification devices jk, priority time-sensitive, tag zigbee-coordinator-offline, message says to power-cycle the UZG then reload ZHA

userStories.title: Z-Wave controller offline alert
acceptanceCriteria: trigger: ZWA-2 controller entity to unavailable for 3 min
time-sensitive push, tag zwave-controller-offline, message says to check zwave-js-ui on hermes

userStories.title: UPS offline alert
acceptanceCriteria: trigger: sensor.apc_ups_status to unavailable (plus unknown if needed) for 3 min

userStories.title: Validate
userStories.description: YAML parse, modern syntax, unique ids and basenames, config check without restart
acceptanceCriteria: All files parse and use modern syntax only
config check passes; no HA restart
